svg.title: L4 Detail -- Order process
svg.desc: A timer starts the process each time an order is received. A sub-process creates the invoice. If an invoice id is set while it runs, the process archives the invoice as an external task. Redrawn from the Camunda BPM order-handling example (Apache-2.0).
